subject: Hosted rate units: mapping Chat / Responses / legacy endpoints (Cartwheel)
messages:
From: Dana Park <procurement@cartwheel.io>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick clarification on hosted rate units (Chat vs Responses vs legacy)

Hi Diego —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our finance and platform teams are trying to map Redwood's hosted pricing to our internal metering. A couple quick asks so we can finish the RFQ: 

- Can you confirm when a request is billed as Chat Completions vs Responses vs "legacy" endpoint units? We have examples where the same prompt/response pair shows up very differently in usage reports.
- Baseline pricing: what are the unit prices for Hosted Chat, Hosted Responses, and the legacy chat endpoint (per 1k tokens or equivalent)?
- Do committed monthly seats/units get a different granularity (e.g., do discounts apply to Responses only or across all endpoint types)?

We need a concise mapping and an example invoice line we can pass to finance. Also attaching our expected monthly token distribution if it helps (sent separately).

Thanks —
Dana Park
Procurement, Cartwheel Labs
procurement@cartwheel.io

From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Dana Park <procurement@cartwheel.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick clarification on hosted rate units (Chat vs Responses vs legacy)

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answer up front: billing is endpoint-based but we provide a consistent token-conversion mapping so you can reconcile across endpoints. I attached our latest ratecard (redwood_ratecard_q3_v2.pdf) and put a short worked example below.

Summary mapping (high level):
- Chat Completions (new chat API): billed per response-tokens + prompt-tokens, priced under "Hosted Chat" SKU.
- Responses (responses endpoint): billed per generated tokens only; optimized for server-side generation workloads where prompt-side client costs are negligible.
- Legacy /api/v1/chat: mapped to the Hosted Chat SKU for invoicing, but we report it as "legacy chat" lines in usage exports for backward compatibility.

Worked example (approx):
- Example request: user prompt 200 tokens, model returns 400 tokens.
  - Hosted Chat: billed as 600 tokens (prompt+response) => 0.6k tokens * unit price.
  - Responses: billed as 400 tokens (generated only) => 0.4k tokens * Responses unit price.
  - Legacy: billed as Hosted Chat SKU (600 tokens) but show legacy endpoint id in the CSV.

Discounts & committed units:
- Discounts apply at the SKU level (Hosted Chat, Responses, Embeddings). For a multi-SKU commit we can either:
  1) Apply an aggregate committed-dollar discount across the invoice, or
  2) Apply per-SKU committed rates (preferred for clarity).

Action items I can do right now:
- Share the attached ratecard with per-SKU unit prices and a mapping table (attached).
- If you send a rough expected monthly split (Chat vs Responses), we can model two discount scenarios: blended discount vs per-SKU commit.

Looping Marissa for discount guidance and Karthik for confirmation of how the usage export labels legacy endpoints.

Best,
Diego Fernández
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Dana / Tom —

Thanks — quick update and proposed next steps, per internal alignment: 

1) Attached is the Redwood ratecard (redwood_ratecard_q3_v2.pdf) with per-SKU list prices and a conversion table for Chat vs Responses vs legacy endpoint labels.

2) Baseline list prices (examples from attached):
   - Hosted Chat (per 1k tokens, prompt+response): $3.50
   - Responses (per 1k generated tokens): $2.80
   - Legacy chat endpoint: billed under Hosted Chat SKU (same economics as Hosted Chat) but exported as "legacy_chat" in CSVs.

3) Discount options we can offer: 
   - Option A (per-SKU commit): 15% off per-SKU if you commit to $150k/month total across Hosted Chat + Responses for 12 months.
   - Option B (blended): 12% off total monthly invoice with appendix showing SKU breakout at list price.

4) Example invoice line (blended mode):
   - Cartwheel Labs — December usage — 1) Hosted Chat 120k tokens @ $3.50/1k = $420.00; 2) Responses 400k generated @ $2.80/1k = $1,120.00; subtotal $1,540.00; discount 12% = -$184.80; total $1,355.20. (CSV labels included for reconciliation.)

Next steps: If you confirm an expected monthly split (approx tokens by endpoint) I’ll ask Marissa to generate two quote variants and we’ll route the preferred one for signature. Also let me know if you want the reconciliation CSV template — Karthik can produce it with the legacy_export_endpoint column.

Best regards,
